title: Hierogrammatic
summary: HIEROGRAMMAT'IC, adjective [Gr. sacred, and letter.] Denoting a kind of writing in sacred or sacerdotal characters, used only by the priests in Egypt.

inlines.v: HIEROGRAMMAT'IC, adjective [Gr. sacred, and letter.] Denoting a kind of writing in sacred or sacerdotal characters, used only by the priests in Egypt.
